where: The Three Hours set-piece battles (Gloamber, Noctilune, Erstmorn — the legendary trio)
mood: Fighting a keeper of the sky's turning — awed, patient and vast, like a great clock: a jammed wheel rocking toward the next hour.
core_styles: 3/4 waltz time like a great clock
low pendulum bass swinging root and fifth every bar
deep tolling tower bell on the hour
soft clock-tick percussion: woodblock and tom on the downbeat
awed mysterious legendary encounter, vast and ancient, solemn but tense

sections.name: The Hour Strikes
sections.text: {on beat one: a sharp orchestral hit with timpani, the pendulum bass and ticking percussion already in motion, straight into the theme}
styles: full ensemble from the first beat

sections.name: First Strophe
sections.text: {the patient minor melody rises in a lifting leap then settles stepwise, over the swinging pendulum bass and clock-tick percussion; the phrase hangs unresolved on the minor fifth chord}

sections.name: Second Strophe
sections.text: {the melody again an octave higher with strings fuller and a bell marking every second bar; the cadence falls deceptively to the sixth chord}

sections.name: The Turning Wheel
sections.text: {contrast: the music turns to F major and C major, the melody broader and more urgent, timpani rolls and a rising string line, the great wheel straining to turn}

sections.name: Third Strophe
sections.text: {the patient minor melody returns in full; it finally reaches the major dominant chord with a strong leading tone, and the last bar leads straight back into the first strophe}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
